prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Find Your Perfect Desktop Companion", "Select a personality archetype to reveal matching desktop pet companions.", "Playful Explorer, Calm Study Buddy, Energetic Guardian"]
1: ["Upload Your Pet Photo", "Ensure high lighting and clear contrast for best rendering results.", "Verify Image Quality", "Photo Quality & Outline Check", "We analyzed your photo. Confirm the pet border cutout looks accurate before generating.", "Pet photo cutout preview", "Looks Great, Generate Pet"]
2: []
3: ["Try Controlling Your Desktop Pet Right Now!", "Practice clicking, dragging, and using tray shortcuts before completing onboarding.", "1. Click pet to interact | 2. Right-click for options | 3. Double-click tray icon to hide", "I'm Ready!"]
4: ["Spawning Pet onto Your Desktop...", "Checking overlay permissions and graphics driver status to guarantee instant screen rendering.", "Display Overlay: Active | System Tray: Docked"]
5: ["Sign In to Save Your Companion", "Signing into an existing account will restore your cloud pets without deleting your new adoption.", "Safe Sync Active: Existing pets will not be overwritten"]
6: ["Choose Your Path & Claim Exclusive Starter Hat", "Select standard or custom path now to equip your pet with a free onboarding halo item.", "Bonus Gift: Golden Collar unlocked on selection"]
7: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Screen!", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to summon/hide your pet, or right-click system tray.", "Finish & Launch"]
8: ["Pet ready spawn chime"]
9: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Buddy", "Desktop pet walking across real desktop background video"]
